snippet.title: Appulse Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
Protect your mothership from waves of invading robots in this fast-paced shooter roguelite inspired by pinball mechanics. Master precision shots, upgrade your arsenal, and fight to turn the tide of war.

Developed by Le Rado and published by Raw Fury.
